entities.summary: Giovanna Giordano is an Italian writer and journalist. She has three award-winning and critically acclaimed novels published to date: Trentaseimila giorni, Un volo magico and Il Mistero di Lithian. Her first novel Cina cara io ti canto, unpublished, was a finalist for the fifth annual Premio Calvino, recommended by Gesualdo Bufalino.
